summary: Remote WebSocket peer controls local PTY and triggers package auto-upgrade on installer host
details: The agent's main entry point opens a WebSocket to a configured server and dispatches incoming messages to handlers that write directly into a local PTY (term.pty.write(msg.data)), perform filesystem and git operations, and run an 'upgrade_agent' path that resolves @yeaft/webchat-agent@latest from npm and executes upgrade.sh / upgrade.bat to reinstall and restart the service under systemd/launchd/PM2. Any party controlling the WebSocket server obtains interactive shell execution on the installer's host and can force arbitrary future versions of the package to be installed and started as a persistent service. service/linux.js also modifies PATH to prepend ~/.local/bin and ~/.npm-global/bin as part of installing the agent as a persistent service.
